correctness.rationale: For the explicitly defined irreducible eight-state continuous-time generator, the tilted Perron eigenvalue determines all long-time marked counting cumulants. A normalized stationary vector and all five centered Poisson correctors were derived and checked by direct exact-rational SymPy reconstruction of the accepted-event transitions. The ten distinct cross-covariance pairs and five diagonal Fano factors exactly equal the rational formulas in RESULT.md. Every sign follows from a strictly positive-coefficient numerator polynomial and a strictly positive denominator. Two derivative numerators have fixed coefficient signs; the third factors by a strictly increasing cubic with one positive root. The packaged verifier repeats all algebra from generated generator entries, and selected mixed Perron eigenvalue Hessians agree in separate numerical finite-difference comparisons. These calculations prove statements for every real w>0, not merely finite samples.

originality.rationale: The source paper arXiv:2611.07053 uses precisely the same open-chain transport type but assesses stationary density profiles, regime crossovers and spatial equal-time occupation covariance, whereas the claim is the complete five-mark integrated event-count second-cumulant sign and Fano-shape classification on the minimal three-site chain. The classic TASEP-LK reference treats density/domain-wall behavior. The periodic LK reference does not have open boundary count channels. Open TASEP current full-count statistics omit bulk Langmuir exchanges. A nearby indexed result on reaction--transport covariances requires circulation-balanced networks, which the directed open chain is not; its published summary does not imply the present formula or sign classification. Search results did not identify a broader applicable theorem. An unindexed earlier exact five-mark counting formula remains possible and is explicitly treated as a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: A general previously published (possibly unindexed) small-chain marked-count cumulant derivation could imply the same rational formulas and global sign classification.
Old TASEP-LK 2004 and periodic-LK 2016 full appendices were not exhaustively read; only primary model and central outcomes were inspected.
Closest published indexed network finding was available as summary, not full-text; its stated circulation-balance condition prevents direct coverage of the current open driven chain.
The result is confined to rate-one boundaries/hops and balanced positive middle-site exchange, not arbitrary rates or longer chains.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete five-channel second-cumulant classification for the smallest open exclusion chain with a genuine interior Langmuir exchange site. As a result, boundary injection/extraction, on/off exchange and transport have three sharply different noise responses to the same physically meaningful control rate. The exact sign of every distinct cross-channel fluctuation and the unique hopping Fano maximum provide a mesoscopic transport noise benchmark not implied by stationary density data; the claim is a complete global parameter classification over w>0, not a one-off special-number exercise. No macroscopic universality or experimental estimation guarantee is claimed.
